resources.string: The price is per month. Each month is delivered within %1$d days; the client confirms and pays every month, and either of you ends it with notice.
A monthly service must deliver every level (with its extras) in %1$d days or less.
This month ends on %1$s — the client can confirm the next one now
Accept the first month in the waiting orders to start it.
The client is ending it — it ends on %1$s
You are ending it — it ends on %1$s
The client did not confirm the next month
Ending takes notice: asked %1$d days or more before this month ends, it ends with this month; later, it ends with the next one. You can take it back until then.
The client is told when it ends
Make a service monthly in its form, and clients who subscribe show here.
